name: Shibuya-Kei
summary: More than just a music genre, Shibuya-kei was an all-encompassing aesthetic that manifested in fashion, graphic design, and a particular lifestyle of elevated consumerism.
description: More than just a music genre, Shibuya-kei was an all-encompassing aesthetic that manifested in fashion, graphic design, and a particular lifestyle of elevated consumerism. It was a byproduct of Japan's economic boom, which allowed a new generation of affluent, urban youth to access a vast library of imported music and fashion from Shibuya's many record stores, which they then reinterpreted into a new, distinctly Japanese style. [ 2 ]
culturalContext: Key values (per the Aesthetics Wiki): Eclecticism, nostalgia, sophistication, cosmopolitanism, consumerism as curation
